briefdescription.para: The following variables are shared between non-interrupt processing and interrupt processing such that they must be global.
The following variable tracks any errors that occur during interrupt processing.
The following variable allows a test value to be added to the values that are written to the FLASH such that unique values can be generated to guarantee the writes to the FLASH were successful.
Handles the processing for the QSPI driver.

detaileddescription.para: It is called from an interrupt context such that the amount of processing performed should be minimized. It is called when a transfer of QSPI data completes or an error occurs.
This handler provides an example of how to handle QSPI interrupts but is application specific.

parameterdescription.para: A reference passed to the handler.

briefdescription.para: Writes to the serial FLASH connected to the QSPI interface.

detaileddescription.para: All the data put into the buffer must be in the same page of the device with page boundaries being on 256 byte boundaries.

parameterdescription.para: Pointer to the QSPI driver component to use.
The address to write data to in the FLASH.
The number of bytes to write.
The command used to write data to the flash. QSPI device supports only Page Program command to write data to the flash.

briefdescription.para: Reads from the serial FLASH connected to the QSPI interface.

The command used to read data from the flash. QSPI device supports one of the Read, Fast Read, Dual Read and Fast Read commands to read data from the flash.

simplesect.para: In XSCT/classic flow, the device configuration is looked up based on DeviceId. The function calls other functions which contain loops that may be infinite if interrupts are not working such that it may not return. If the device slave select is not correct and the device is not responding on bus it reads a status of 0xFF for the status register as the bus is pulled up.
